_README: A VARIANT is one vault this repo can build: the seed notes beside this file,
plus the frontmatter and two banner constants the Dashboard assembler bakes
into Dashboard.md. Everything shared between variants lives in dev/common/.
This repo ships exactly one variant, `template`, and it is the vault at
`Storm Dashboard Vault/`. To keep a private vault of your own, add a sibling
directory (dev/<name>/) with its own variant.json and seeds, add it to
.gitignore, and build it with `npm run build -- --variant <name>`. No variant's
content lives in the build scripts — they only read this file.
label: Storm Dashboard Vault (the published template)
